block.title: CI compiles each glibc proof tree with Make
block.p: At revision f06130b451e4, Nix evaluated 1,442 sealed compiles, 812 additional interface compiles and 1,441 abstract compiles. CI now gives each runtime one Nix derivation. Rocq lists the imports and Make compiles the files in dependency order. A proof edit rebuilds the sealed tree on push, and each importer loads the full object of the file it depends on.

Locally, rq verify DIR/FILE.v checks the saved file against the native interfaces of its imports. The scheduled build checks every runtime-general proof against the abstract runtime and compares the Hello theorem’s assumptions with its expected runtime fields.
